Mission Local reported in May 2016 that San Francisco’s Recreation and Parks Department had reinstated reservations for parts of Dolores Park, charging fees from $33 to $325, plus a $200 security deposit. The reservable areas included open grass, picnic tables and an overlook. After public backlash and objections from supervisors about restricting access to public space, the department agreed to suspend lawn reservations and limit reservations to picnic tables.
